text:
Matthew Schaefer is 19, he won the Calder last season, and somehow he has found another gear. He is playing 26:45 a night for the Islanders, two minutes more than as a rookie, and has 26 points in 22 games, up from 0.72 a game to 1.18. Last Tuesday he scored his first career hat trick against Columbus on nine shots.

The hot stretch is earned. He has 15 points in his last ten games when we'd expect about 10.7 at his minutes, and the chances on his own shots are up too. His skating is the headline: his top speed ranks in the 98th percentile and his bursts over 20 mph rank at the very top of the league. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 36% of his shots coming off the rush, about twice the typical defenseman.

Some regression is coming. He has 9 goals on 6.4 expected. But Evolving-Hockey had him playing with weak teammates last season and still driving play at the 99th percentile. Picked first overall to change a franchise, he is doing it on schedule.
headline: At 19, Schaefer is already carrying the Islanders
